description: A disease caused by the Zika virus, which is spread to people primarily through the bite of an infected Aedes species mosquito.
treatment_action: Rest, fluids, and acetaminophen for fever and pain.
complications: Microcephaly and other birth defects if infected during pregnancy.

description: A rare condition in which tumors in the pancreas or duodenum cause the stomach to produce too much acid.
causes: Gastrinomas (tumors) that secrete excessive gastrin hormone.
treatment_action: Proton pump inhibitors, surgery to remove tumors.

description: A serious fungal infection caused by molds called mucormycetes.
causes: Inhalation or contact with fungal spores, often in immunocompromised patients.
prevention: Avoid areas with dust and soil if immunocompromised.
treatment_action: Antifungal medications, surgical removal of infected tissue.
complications: Spread to brain, blindness, death if untreated.

description: A pouch that forms in the throat due to weakness in the throat muscles.
causes: Weakness in the muscles of the throat wall, often age-related.
treatment_action: Surgery to remove or repair the diverticulum.

description: A condition caused by insufficient zinc in the diet or poor zinc absorption.
causes: Poor diet, malabsorption, chronic diseases, or increased zinc needs.
prevention: Eat zinc-rich foods (meat, shellfish, legumes, seeds).
complications: Impaired immune function, growth retardation in children.

description: A viral infection that causes a painful rash, caused by reactivation of the chickenpox virus.
symptoms: Red rash that develops into fluid-filled blisters
prevention: Shingles vaccine, especially for adults over 50.
treatment_action: Antiviral medications, pain relievers, topical treatments.

description: A break in the cheekbone (zygomatic bone), often from facial trauma.
causes: Facial trauma from accidents, sports injuries, or violence.
prevention: Use protective equipment in sports, practice safety measures.
treatment_action: Surgery to realign and stabilize the bone.
complications: Permanent facial deformity, nerve damage, vision problems.

description: A rare but serious fungal infection caused by zygomycete fungi.
causes: Inhalation or wound contamination with zygomycete spores.
prevention: Avoid exposure to contaminated soil and organic matter if immunocompromised.
treatment_action: Aggressive antifungal therapy and surgical debridement.
complications: Rapid spread, organ failure, high mortality rate.
